audit.why: 50.7% over 785 games and the chart gives Olaf five of seven stages — a level-1 steal and then a long defensive lane. The prose is honest about that.
Spike placement is right: your level 1, his levels 2-3 once Reckless Swing sustains, his level 6 Ragnarok, his two-item lifesteal timing.

audit.whatIsWrong: Four separate mechanical errors: Undertow is labelled his E, Ragnarok is credited with true damage in four strings, Pantheon is given a 'W shield' twice, and Reckless Swing's health cost is said to reset off the axe pickup.
audit.why: Undertow is his Q and Reckless Swing is his E, so the page calls two different abilities 'E' in the same sentence and the reader cannot tell which cooldown to count. Ragnarok deals no damage whatsoever — Riot's text is 'passively gains increased armor and magic resist. He can activate this ability to become immune to disables for as long as he keeps attacking.' The true damage belongs to Reckless Swing, and putting it on the ultimate tells the player the damage arrives on a 100s cooldown when it actually arrives every 11 seconds. Pantheon's W is Shield Vault, a dash and a stun; he has no W shield, and pointing at a defence he does not have is how a player mistimes the one he does. Finally Riot's Reckless Swing text says it refunds the health cost 'if he destroys the target' — a kill refund, not something the axe pickup resets; the axe pickup shortens Undertow.
audit.corrected: Undertow named as his Q, the true damage moved to Reckless Swing with its 11s cooldown, the phantom W shield removed, and the health-cost refund tied to kills.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ragnarok is described as an unconditional wall, and the condition attached to it is never stated.
audit.why: Riot: he is immune to disables 'for as long as he keeps attacking'. The immunity is sustained by him continuing to attack, so it is not a fixed timer you simply wait out — breaking away and denying him targets is what ends it. That is real, actionable counterplay against the ability the page calls the lane-breaker, and it was absent.
audit.corrected: Written into mid and the level-6 spike.

edits.before: Your W-stun into empowered-Q burst is your real kill window, but every trade he kites toward his thrown axe to slow you and reset Reckless Swing's health cost.
edits.after: Shield Vault into empowered Comet Spear is your real kill window, but he walks over his thrown Undertow axe to slow you and cut its 9s cooldown.

edits.before: His Ragnarok (R) is the wall: it makes him CC-immune so your W stun does nothing, and its true damage ignores your E block and W shield.
edits.after: Ragnarok is the wall: it makes him immune to disables so Shield Vault does nothing — but only while he keeps attacking, so break away.

edits.before: Use E's directional block to eat his thrown axe (E) and deny the slow that sets up his all-in
edits.after: Face Aegis Assault at his thrown Undertow axe and deny the slow that starts each all-in

edits.before: Hit 6 and Ragnarok (R) through your W stun and E block for an unkillable true-damage all-in
edits.after: Hit 6 and Ragnarok straight through your stun, then keep attacking to hold the immunity

edits.before: Ragnarok makes him CC-immune so your W stun does nothing, and its true damage ignores your E block and W shield entirely.
edits.after: Ragnarok makes him immune to disables so Shield Vault does nothing, and Reckless Swing's true damage ignores Aegis Assault.

edits.before: Level 1 is your moment — your point-and-click W stun plus an auto is the strongest level-1 in the game, so trade hard before Olaf gets any axe lifesteal going. Hold-aim Q from max range to poke and shove; the farther it travels the more it hurts, and it out-ranges his thrown axe. The danger is his E axe slow: if it lands he kites toward it, slows you, and Reckless Swing chunks you while his lifesteal heals it back, so save E to block the axe rather than to chase.
edits.after: Level 1 is your moment — point-and-click Shield Vault plus an auto is the strongest level-1 in the game, so trade hard before Olaf stacks any lifesteal. Hold-aim Comet Spear at max range to poke and shove; it outranges his thrown axe. The danger is Undertow (Q), his axe: it slows you, he walks over it to cut its 9s cooldown, and then Reckless Swing (E) chunks you with true damage his lifesteal heals back. Face Aegis Assault at the axe rather than spending it to chase.

edits.before: By Levels 4-5 the math flips against you. Your empowered-Q poke is real, but Olaf heals it with lifesteal and Reckless Swing's sustain, so you can't grind him down the way you grind a Nasus or Sett. At 6 his Ragnarok is the lane-breaker: it strips all slows AND makes him CC-immune, so your W stun whiffs and his R deals true damage that ignores your E block and W shield. Do not all-in into an up Ragnarok — bait it, disengage, and only commit when it's on cooldown.
edits.after: By 4-5 the math flips. Empowered Comet Spear is real poke, but Berserker Rage lifesteal grows as he drops, so you cannot grind him down. At 6 Ragnarok is the lane-breaker: it makes him immune to disables, so Shield Vault whiffs. Two things the page never said — Ragnarok itself deals no damage at all, the true damage is Reckless Swing on 11s; and the immunity only holds while he keeps attacking. Break away, deny him a target, and it ends.

edits.before: This is his game, not yours. Olaf out-sustains your poke with lifesteal, and his Reckless Swing true damage plus Ragnarok ignore everything you stack — your shields and E block are worthless against true damage. Your damage plateaus while his axes scale, so a fed Olaf with R up runs you down through any kite. Convert your early tempo into Grand Starfall roams and objectives before two items land; if the lane goes even into the mid game, you have already lost it.
edits.after: This is his game. Berserker Rage gives him more attack speed and lifesteal the lower he gets, so hurting him makes him stronger, and Reckless Swing's true damage walks through any armour you bought — Aegis Assault only ever stopped damage from the front anyway. Your damage plateaus while his scales. Convert the early tempo into Grand Starfall roams and objectives before two items land; even into the mid game means you have lost.

notes: FOUR ERRORS ON ONE PAGE. (1) Undertow was labelled 'thrown axe (E)' while Reckless Swing was also called E — two different abilities sharing a letter in the same sentence. Undertow is Q. (2) Ragnarok was credited with true damage in four strings. It deals no damage at all: Riot's text is passive armour and magic resist plus an activation granting immunity to disables. The true damage is Reckless Swing, which matters enormously for timing — the page had the player expecting that damage on a 100s ultimate when it lands every 11 seconds. (3) 'Your E block and W shield' appears twice. Pantheon's W is Shield Vault, a dash and stun; there is no W shield. That is the same fossil the nasus and masteryi pages carry in other forms. (4) The packet's suspectName on 'Reckless Swing's' was a real hit, though not a naming error: the page said picking up the axe resets Reckless Swing's health cost. Riot refunds that cost 'if he destroys the target' — a kill refund. The axe pickup shortens Undertow's cooldown. BEST ADDITION: Ragnarok's immunity lasts 'for as long as he keeps attacking', so denying him a target ends it. The page called it an unconditional wall. REJECTED: _missing-interactions.json claims Olaf can cancel your Aegis Assault with Ragnarok. Ragnarok applies no crowd control to enemies — the hardCC flag has picked up the phrase 'immune to disables' — so I did not write it.
